questions.question: Which strait separates India from Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation: The Palk Strait separates India and Sri Lanka.

questions.question: GST was implemented in India on:
questions.explanation: GST came into effect on 1 July 2017.

questions.question: Who composed the song "Vande Mataram"?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote "Vande Mataram".

questions.question: The national bird of India is the:
questions.explanation: The Indian peacock is the national bird.

questions.question: Who is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: The President is the supreme commander of the armed forces.

questions.question: The Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha) was led by Mahatma Gandhi in which year?
questions.explanation: The Dandi March began on 12 March 1930.

questions.question: The First Battle of Panipat (1526) was fought between Babur and:
questions.explanation: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi in 1526, founding the Mughal Empire.

questions.question: Which is the largest gland in the human body?
questions.explanation: The liver is the largest gland in the human body.

questions.question: Which vitamin is produced when skin is exposed to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Sunlight triggers Vitamin D synthesis in the skin.

questions.question: The Thar Desert is located mainly in which state?
questions.explanation: The Thar Desert lies mostly in Rajasthan.

questions.question: The financial year in India runs from:
questions.explanation: India’s financial year is April to March.

questions.question: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the:
questions.explanation: The Vice-President chairs the Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: Which is the smallest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Goa is the smallest Indian state by area.

questions.question: How many members can the President nominate to the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The President nominates 12 members to the Rajya Sabha for expertise in arts, science, etc.

questions.question: The national flower of India is the:
questions.explanation: The lotus is India’s national flower.

questions.question: The Nobel Prize is NOT awarded in which field?
questions.explanation: There is no Nobel Prize in Mathematics.

questions.question: The Indus Valley Civilisation is also known as the:
questions.explanation: It is called the Harappan Civilisation after Harappa, its first excavated site.

questions.question: The Param Vir Chakra is awarded for:
questions.explanation: The Param Vir Chakra is India’s highest wartime gallantry award.

questions.question: The maximum strength of the Lok Sabha as per the Constitution is:
questions.explanation: The Constitution permits a maximum of 550 elected members in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: The capital of British India was shifted from Calcutta to Delhi in:
questions.explanation: The capital was shifted to Delhi in 1911.

Find the compound interest on ₹4000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.

An article costing ₹460 is sold at a 25% profit. Find the selling price.
Find the average of the first five multiples of 4.
questions.explanation: Multiples: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20. Sum = 60. Average = 60/5 = 12.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 8 and their sum is 104. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 13. Each part = 104/13 = 8. Larger = 8 × 8 = 64.

questions.question: A train 180 m long crosses a pole in 9 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 20 days and B in 5 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/20 + 1/5 = 25/100. Time = 100/25 = 4 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 7 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = (22/7) × 7² = 154 cm².

questions.question: Find the value of √256.
After a 10% discount, an item costs ₹450. Find its marked price.
Find 50% of 10% of 2000.
Two numbers are in the ratio 4 : 7 and their difference is 12. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 3 parts = 12, so each part = 4. Smaller = 4 × 4 = 16.

questions.question: A boat travels 45 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 45/3 = 15 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 15 − 4 = 11 km/h.

questions.question: If today is Friday, what day will it be after 63 days?
questions.explanation: 63 mod 7 = 0; Friday + 0 = Friday.

questions.question: Which letter is 8th to the right of the 13th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 13th letter = M; 13 + 8 = 21th letter = U.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (6, 216), (3, 27), (7, 347), (5, 125)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 7³ = 343, not 347.

questions.question: In a row of 28 students, Ravi is 7th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 28 − 7 + 1 = 22.

questions.question: Find the next term: 36, 49, 64, 81, 100, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 6²…10². Next is 11² = 121.

questions.question: Find the next term: 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 1 each step; next difference is 6, so 16 + 6 = 22.

questions.question: If TREE is coded as XVII, how is SUN coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 4. Applying the same to SUN gives WYR.
The relation is squaring: 9² = 81, so 12² = 144.

questions.question: A person walks 9 km East and then 12 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(9² + 12²) = √225 = 15 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 8 + 3 × 6.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 8 × 3 − 6 = 24 − 6 = 18.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 16, 49, 148, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×3 + 1: 148 × 3 + 1 = 445.

questions.question: Complete the series: F, I, L, O, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 3 places, so the next is R.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 31, 3, 2, 24
questions.explanation: 2, 31, 3 are prime numbers; 24 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 11th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 11th letter from the right is the 16th from the left = P.
